title: Prove a cost-39 floor for sparse rational E6 corrections (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a new support obstruction for PR2240's fixed one-extra rank-one E6 correction. Claim type: scoped written invoice proof with exact finite corroboration.

```text
s = number of nonzero coordinates of a
ε = 1 when a_2 is nonzero, otherwise 0
C >= 42 - s - ε

support(a) <= 2  =>  fully charged cost >= 39
```

The charged-moment lower profile is `(s+1)` rank-five, `(5-s+ε)` rank-six and `(1-ε)` rank-seven terms, for every positive power. Two-coordinate corrections that exclude coordinate two cost at least 40. Every rational coefficient and every nonzero rational lambda are covered; these sparse corrections automatically have seven nonzero terms.

The proof retains every unchanged term and charges the changed and extra terms their inherited five-unit floor. The relaxation is sharp, but actual decoder attainment and exact minimum are unclaimed. Matching cost 37 requires at least four correction coordinates, with coordinate two included when exactly four are used.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337, [PR2240](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2240), head `c8a2b37056e766715c457f56e2dd8172f5bdbccd`, for the factorization, fixed ranks, tariff and finite-alphabet screen; PR1590 and its root-unit lineage; PR2247's distinct sheared-base family; and DreamingOfClouds / PR2277's broader root-code floor 36. Their mathematical results are cited premises, not audit or replay deliverables.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19371202) and [scoped finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19371556). The delivered result is the first support obstruction; the predicted exact two-parameter arrangement is unrun.

## Evidence

Before: the broader root-code theorem gives floor 36, while PR2240's direction screen is finite. After: the written fixed-term argument gives floor 39 on every rational two-coordinate direction in this fixed base.

Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library only:

- Both registered warning-strict normal/optimized commands pass, timed at 0.086s and 0.088s. These are local check-duration observations, not a speedup claim.
- All 63 nonempty supports and 12,285 abstract invoices satisfy the moment-profile and scalar-floor checks. Every abstract support minimum attains the formula. The 240 new rational fixtures preserve coefficient cancellation and unchanged terms. Five invalid supports are rejected.
- Four scientific mutations and one source-byte corruption are rejected in both normal and optimized modes. No predecessor scientific census or pairing-rank calculation was rerun.
- Metadata/source pins, seven-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, AST compilation and whitespace checks pass. Official export integrity and declared-input coverage pass. Both direct modes pass from a read-only Git-free export with identical receipts and all eight bundled files unchanged.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -X dev -W error -B research/e6-sparse-correction-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -X dev -W error -B research/e6-sparse-correction-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e6-sparse-correction-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/e6-sparse-correction-floor --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 installation can replace the absolute interpreter path. Direct output is `PASS_E6_SPARSE_CORRECTION_FLOOR`; receipts are generated from file hashes. Scientific base is canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. Main was unchanged at the submission refresh. TASK.json declares the scoped side result rather than claiming the card's complete supplier gate.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Fully charged Theorem C invoice only. This is not a raw-rank floor, attained decoder optimum or physical supplier bill. The general formula requires seven genuine terms; the proof establishes that condition for all directions with at most two nonzero coordinates. Dense directions and changed bases remain separate.

Actual minimum, simultaneous rank compatibility, native realization, ownership/restoration, routing, precision/tape, stock, compiler and outer costs are unrun or unresolved. All five selected assumptions remain. No new kappa, selected-frontier change, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human and formal proof-kernel review were not run or claimed.

## Open next questions

- Can a genuine fixed-base correction attain the support-only floor at support four or five? Start with an explicit rational direction and simultaneous pairing-rank constraints. The abstract minimum supplies no compatible decoder.
- What is the exact minimum on `a=e_1+t e_2`? Start with its rational support-change arrangement. Attainment of 39 is unclaimed.
- Can a changed base and complete physical caller use a lower algebraic bill? Its complete native/frame/restoration/outer contract is still missing.

## Related open work

- [PR6584](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6584) accelerates the A2+E6 COPY69 primary replay. This contribution studies a different fixed 36-line E6 correction invoice and does not evaluate its COPY69 quantity.
- [PR3049](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3049) uses E6 dimension covers in P112 residue closures. Those cover constraints differ from this support-sensitive rank-one correction bill; no numerical comparison is made.

The completion refresh listed all 14 other open account PRs created since the claim. PR6584 is covered above. The additional [PR6582](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6582) classifies full-E8 A2 equality fibers; its support-incidence quantity differs from this fixed 36-line E6 correction invoice. No additional calculation checked another contribution, and no competing value for this correction bill was identified in those PRs.

The completed checks were read once with `gh pr checks`; run metadata confirms completed status, success and the matching head. These checks do not establish independent human review, proof-kernel acceptance or supplier admission.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Adds six files under one opt-in research directory; the declared input, frozen sources, shared code and selected record are unchanged.
